fusions.name: Long Draw
fusions.desc: Draws for 1.2 seconds, then looses a javelin that deals 34 damage to the first enemy it meets and ignores armour.

fusions.name: Quiver at the Hip
fusions.desc: Looses 3 light darts at once in a spread out to 7 tiles, and each deals 6 damage. Holds 4 charges; each use spends one, and each kill restores one.

fusions.name: Thrower's Lever
fusions.desc: For 20 seconds, your attacks and spells reach 54% further.

fusions.name: Held Breath
fusions.desc: The moment your stamina is full, your physical damage rises by 25% for 5 seconds. Once every 15 seconds.
